spindle.observe.SeedState.title: SeedState
spindle.observe.SeedState.description: The answer of `GET /__spindle/seed`, with or without `--observe` and without the host's thread: the state of the seed run under way, or of the last one, and its counts, that run's alone, as the seed's end line prints them. A reset with no world starts a new seed run, which reads `running` from before the reset empties the stores, with its own counts, until it ends. On a run without a seed only `state` is given, `none`.

entries.description: The entries of the seed file.

left.description: The entries of this run not yet done: not yet sent, or recorded rejected by the state and sent again first. 0 once it has ended.

sent.description: Entries this run sent; each is then counted once in one of the four below.

already_there.description: Entries an outcome declared `existing_instance:` answered, or whose request id an earlier applied or already-there entry carried.

refused.description: Entries a declared refusing outcome answered.

rejected.description: Entries that did not run: the host or the kernel refused them before an outcome. A seed run that ends with one stops the run with exit 1.

spindle.observe.SeedStateKind.title: SeedStateKind
spindle.observe.SeedStateKind.description: Where a served run's seed is. `none`: the run has no seed. `running`: an entry of the seed run under way is left, or the last one's submission has not returned. `ended`: the last entry's submission has returned, so whatever it wrote is in place, whatever each entry became; also from the first request of a start whose `--state` records every entry done.
